title: NP lies in the union of polynomial nondeterministic time classes
statement: Every language in $\mathrm{NP}$ belongs to $\bigcup_{c\in\mathbb{N}}\mathrm{NTIME}(n\mapsto n^c+1)$.
replaced: Every language in $\mathrm{NP}$ (given by a polynomial-time verifier with certificates of exact polynomial length) belongs to $\bigcup_{c} \mathrm{NTIME}(n^c + 1)$.
